name: marker
title: Marker
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Marker (a line inside a conversation, such as 'Today', 'Model switched to ...' or 'Context compacted'): lettering, small, uppercase, always ink (never grey). variant separator draws a 1px ink rule on both sides; variant border draws a 1px ink rule under it. Links inside take the underline hover and the focus ring. MarkerIcon stays in ink.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/marker". It wraps your own components/ui/marker, so Radix and Base UI both work: never pass render or asChild.

meta.tagline: A line in the conversation: a date, a switch, a compaction.
meta.usage:
import { Marker, MarkerIcon, MarkerContent } from "@/components/ui/manga/marker"

<Marker variant="separator">
  <MarkerContent>Today</MarkerContent>
</Marker>

props.name: variant
props.description: separator: rules on both sides. border: a rule under the line.
